item.description: Join us Thursday, July 23rd for a dinner that is part homecoming, part healing, part celebration — a one-night collaborative preview of a new in-home restaurant rooted in fire, family, and the flavors of Southeast Asia and the Pacific Islands. For one night only, Songbird Parlour welcomes a special collaborative dinner – a four-course preview of a new in-home restaurant inspired by fire, memory, and family. Rooted in Southeast Asian and Pacific island flavors, the menu explores BBQ marinated in aromatics like ginger and lemongrass, then cooked slowly over open flame. item.title: Miso & Koji: A Hands-On Japanese Fermentation Workshop — Sat Jul 25, 10:00 AM — Gather Sebastopol
item.description:
Discover the magic of traditional Japanese fermentation in this hands-on workshop with chef and teacher Hiroko Kurosaki. Together we’ll explore the art of miso and koji, two foundational elements of Japanese cuisine that bring depth, flavor, and nourishment to everyday meals. In this class, you will: • Make your own fresh miso to ferment at home • Create two jars of seasonal vegetable ferments with salt koji • Taste the sweetness of traditional amazake • Leave with the knowledge and confidence to continue your fermenting practice at home Learn time-honored fermentation techniques and bring a piece of Japanese food tradition into your own kitchen.

item.title: Community Seed Exchange-Cultivating Living Soil in the Garden — Sat Jul 25, 10:30 AM — St.Stephen’s Episcopal Church
item.description:
Free Class Parish Hall and in Seed Garden A living, fertile garden soil needs the same things you and I do: Air, the Right Amount of Water, Nourishment, and Protection. We will look at each of these in turn, applying understanding of soil types, climate variations, exposure variations, etc. to our unique garden spots. We will bring in the understanding (from Jesse Frost, “The Living Soil Handbook”) of the three basic principles; John Jeavons 50 50 rule; OAEC’s Process Based Restoration; and the practice of daily observation and patience. Please bring a straight-sided jar with lid, filled ⅓ full with your sifted garden soil, either your native soil or soil from a raised bed. (Sifted just means no rocks, sticks or leaves.) Taught by long time gardener and stalwart CSE volunteer Peggy Rose Seed Garden Work Party 9:00am-10:30am Garden open for wandering or you can lend a hand Seed Library Open on site 9am-noon!
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: A Conversation Between Arthur Drooker and Richard Neill — Sat Jul 25, 12:30 PM — Petaluma Arts Center
item.description:
Please join us for a conversation between Photographer Arthur Drooker and Curator Richard Neill about the inspiration for Arthur's photographic project, “Thirty-Six Views of the Golden Gate Bridge.” The conversation between Drooker and Neill includes the process of creating the exhibit and book and the historical research that went into making the photographs. This will be followed by an audience Q&A. Books will be available for signing at the event. Richard Neill is a Photographer, Filmmaker and Curator and a member of the PAC Exhibitions Committee.
Please note that photography and video recording may take place during this event. By participating, you grant the Petaluma Arts Center permission to use your image for storytelling, marketing, and/or documentation purposes. By registering for this event, you also agree to receive occasional email communications from Petaluma Arts Center. You may unsubscribe at any time. item.title: SEAWOLF Wines Pop-Up Tasting at Gospel Flat Farm in Bolinas — Sat Jul 25, 1:00 PM — Gospel Flat Farm
item.description:
SEAWOLF Wines Pop-Up Tasting in Bolinas Saturday, July 25th 1:00 PM to 5:00PM
Perched among the rugged ridgelines of Anderson Valley, SEAWOLF Wines is a family-owned winery founded by two passionate winemakers who bring the same fearless spirit to their wine grape growing as they do to the waves. Dedicated to organic farming and natural winemaking, Jesse and Emma embrace a minimal-intervention philosophy, allowing each vintage to reflect the intimate relationship between time, nature, and land.
Wine crafted with intention. Shaped by nature. Inspired by adventure.
Join Us in Bolinas
Whether you've just finished an early morning surf at Bolinas, hiked the ridgelines of Mount Tamalpais, or explored Highway 1 by bike, we invite you to slow down and spend the afternoon with us! Join us at Gospel Flat Farm, overlooking the beautiful Bolinas Lagoon, for a tasting of our organically grown, dry-farmed wines in one of West Marin's most scenic settings.

A guided tasting of handcrafte

item.title: Live Music Happy Hour - The Ukulele Ramblers - Open Uke Jam! — Sat Jul 25, 3:00 PM — Barrel Proof Lounge
item.description:
Saturday afternoons hit differently at Barrel Proof Lounge.
We open early — 3pm — and hand the room over to Ukulele Ramblers, a friendly, talented ukulele collective that turns Happy Hour into a laid-back, sing-along hang.
This is live music and an open uke jam. Bring your ukulele if you’ve got one. Bring your voice even if you don’t. The Ramblers lead the way with familiar tunes, easy harmonies, and a welcoming vibe that makes it just as fun to join in as it is to sit back and listen.
No pressure. No ego. Just good songs, good people, and a room that feels like it belongs to everyone.
Live Music & Open Uke Jam | 3–6pm Happy Hour drinks Free popcorn 21+
Barrel Proof Lounge 501 Mendocino Avenue, Downtown Santa Rosa
It’s the kind of afternoon you plan to stop by for one drink… and somehow stay for three hours.
**www.UkuleleRamblers.net**
Check out **www.BarrelProofLounge.com** for all sorts of good times ahead!
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: 150th Fig Tree Party at Quivira Vineyards — Sat Jul 25, 5:00 PM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Guests are invited to a once-in-a-generation celebration honoring the 150th birthday of Quivira's historic fig tree. The evening begins with a 5:00 PM reception featuring Hog Island Oyster Company, followed by a seated, multi-course dinner highlighting seasonal cuisine paired with Quivira wines. Desserts from Cousteaux's will be served alongside live music, creating a festive atmosphere under the stars. Throughout the evening, guests will gather to toast the iconic fig tree and reflect on its legacy and the land, community, and history it represents. Seating is limited, and early reservations are encouraged for this memorable celebration.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Jul 26, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.

Participants are invited to travel across all landscapes, not just their favorite one: dancing by oneself, in duet, in ensemble with several people and eventually the whole room, or witnessing in stillness the beauty of another’s or of everyone’s dance. item.description:
Attention all Beatles fans in the San Francisco Bay Area! Get ready to experience the magic of the Beatles live on stage with Hey Jude, an exciting Beatles tribute band. With their remarkable talent, great harmonies, and passion for the music of the Beatles, Hey Jude will take you on a journey through the timeless classics that defined a generation. From "Hey Jude" to "Let it Be", every song is performed with accuracy and energy that will have you dancing and singing along.
Their electrifying performances will transport you back in time to the golden era of the Beatles and leave you feeling nostalgic and uplifted. Whether you're a lifelong fan or discovering the Beatles for the first time, Hey Jude is the perfect way to experience the music that changed the world.
